# Portfolio Website Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A gradient-mesh/glass portfolio for Prashant, generated by a custom Go static site generator, running locally at `http://localhost:8080`, ready to deploy to `https://prashant263.github.io`.

**Architecture:** Three Go packages with a one-way dependency: `internal/content` (domain types, YAML/Markdown loading from an `fs.FS`, validation) ← `internal/render` (html/template + goldmark, returns bytes, no disk writes) ← `internal/site` (the only package doing file I/O: build `dist/`, copy static, link check). `cmd/build` and `cmd/serve` are thin entry points.

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.24, `gopkg.in/yaml.v3`, `github.com/yuin/goldmark`, vanilla CSS/JS, Web3Forms (contact), GitHub Actions + Pages (deploy, run later by the owner).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-portfolio-design.md`

**Constraint:** Local development only. Do NOT push to GitHub or deploy from this machine. Local `git commit` is fine.
